# Security policy

Security issues in the generator, update automation, provenance checks, or corpus integrity should be reported through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/P4suta/aozora-rights-filtered-corpus/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue for an unpatched vulnerability. Rights-metadata corrections that do not expose a software vulnerability may be filed as a normal issue with the work ID, official card URL, and supporting source.
